thread:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a regression on token-level latency for tool/function calls on prod. Per-token validation up ~15ms on average for /chat/stream starting ~11:55 UTC. Dashboard shows a spike in validation and retries. @sam @tasha

sam: copying in. what's the trace id / sample request? any kernel-selector or runtime change around 11:50-12:00?

maria: trace id 01F3ZQ9K7Y. quick perf sample:
```
perf hotspots (sampled):
- validate_call()         52.3%   (function signature + schema checks)
- serialize_structured()  18.7%   (formatting + json schema)
- kv_cache_lookup()        6.4%
- kernel_dispatch()        5.1%
- batching_overhead()      3.2%
```
p95 validate_call ~ 45ms, baseline was ~28ms

tasha: hmm. we shipped the kernel-selector tweak for llama-13b at 11:54 (fused-attn-v2 preferred). That shouldn't affect validation, but it did change buffer layout and memcpy paths. Could be exposing more copies in the function-calling path.

darren: I rolled that selector at 11:55 UTC in canary then prod at 11:59 via rollout v5. deploy-bot logs:
```
[deploy-bot] rollout v5 -> canary 11:54
[deploy-bot] rollout v5 -> prod   11:59
```

maria: also seeing retries in the function-caller: successful call rate dropped 97% -> 88%, retries inc by ~4x. logs show quick validation failures like "schema mismatch: extraneous field" then a retry with same payload succeeds.

jenna: could be ordering/serialization nondeterminism from new kernel (mem layout) + race in structured serializer. Do we have unit tests covering serialization + validation in parallel? :thinking_face: 

sam: quick checklist:
- get flamegraph for validate_call
- trace kernel dispatch path for that trace id
- run structured serializer microbench with fused-attn-v2 vs baseline kernel
- pin canary back if we confirm

maria: attached flamegraph snippet in thread (inline):
```
flamegraph summary:
validate_call -> parse_payload -> canonicalize -> serialize_structured
serialize_structured -> copy_buf -> format_tokens
```

tasha: I'll run microbench now. initial local run shows serialize_structured p99 +8ms with fused-attn-v2 vs baseline.

darren: I'm going to rollback the kernel-selector in prod canary to previous commit (v4) for 10% traffic and monitor. Rolling back to reduce blast radius.

ops-bot: @darren initiated rollback: selector-rollout v6 -> canary (10%) at 12:19 UTC

maria: thanks. If rollback fixes it we need a regression test in CI that runs structured-output + function-calling validation under both kernel variants. Also add a dashboard panel: token_latency.validation.p50/p95/p99 by route + kernel_variant label.

jenna: Agreed. Proposed dashboard query (PromQL style):
```
sum by(route,kernel_variant)(rate(token_latency_validation_sum[1m])) /
sum by(route,kernel_variant)(rate(token_latency_validation_count[1m]))
```
and
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_validation_bucket[5m])) by (le,route,kernel_variant))
```

sam: plan: 1) confirm rollback improves p95 within 20 mins 2) add regression test + perf job 3) add dashboard panel & alert if validate p95 increases >10ms vs baseline

maria: thanks everyone. will monitor dashboards and post an update in 15m. :thumbsup:
